mentions.name: Leafle
mentions.description: An LLM-powered book recommendation engine. Recent work focuses on filtering OpenRouter providers to avoid getting stuck on a provider that is very slow or does not actually meet its promised tool-calling spec.
mentions.problem: A common failure mode is getting stuck on an OpenRouter provider that is either very slow or doesn't actually meet the spec it promises in terms of tool calling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve carried on working on my llm powered book recommendation engine, Leafle (try it out if you like! https://leafle.nanosheep.net).
mentions.author: kidnoodle
